newsitem.title: FRANCE: Emirates offers ex-France cargo to Sana'a and KL.
newsitem.headline: Emirates offers ex-France cargo to Sana'a and KL.

text.p: The Dubai government-owned Emirates Airline, said it had added two new destinations to its ex-France air cargo network with the introduction of winter timetables.
"We are now offering ex-France cargo capacity to the Yemen capital of Sana'a and Kuala Lumpur via Dubai," an Emirates cargo official told Reuters.

Shipments for these two new destinations are transported aboard Emirates three-times weekly Paris-Dubai and Nice-Rome-Dubai scheduled services operated by Airbus 310 passenger aircraft which can handle up to 12 tonnes of palletised cargo per flight, he added.

The only direct carrier between Paris and Sana'a is Yemenia-Yemen Airways, operating a twice-weekly passenger service using a Boeing 727 aircraft which can accomodate a maximum of four to five tonnes of freight.

Malaysia Airlines operates a three times weekly 747-400 combi service between Paris and Kuala Lumpur while the Malaysian capital is a westbound stopover on Air France's full-freighter services from Singapore. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
